_metadata.description: Bounded, diagnostic test execution that cannot hang or OOM the host.

requirements.title: Bound every test command
requirements.description: The command runner enforces a per-workspace timeout, a no-output watchdog, process-group cleanup on cancel/timeout, bounded concurrency, memory-aware worker caps, and environment isolation, and writes a command log artifact for every command.

validation.notes: Fake executor proves timeout, no-output stall, and cancel each terminate the process group and produce a classified result.

requirements.title: Run registered typed adapters
requirements.description: Registered language/framework adapters submit executable-plus-argv commands with declared artifacts, bounded resources, platform applicability, and honest missing-tool or unsupported outcomes; dependency provisioning remains owned by Scenario Dependency Analyzer.

validation.notes: Each runner builds the expected argv and conservative env against fixtures; real smoke test runs a tiny passing fixture per language available.

requirements.title: Classify every failure
requirements.description: Command results are classified as pass, test-failure, missing-dependency, misconfiguration, timeout/hang, no-output stall, or system-failure, and the classification drives the emitted finding code and severity.

validation.notes: Fixture exit codes / output patterns map to the correct failure class and finding code.
